variants.name: 6.5 GRENDEL
variants.info: A high-precision rifle round designed to give the AR-15 platform performance somewhat comparable to 7.62x51mm, but with around half of the recoil impulse. The larger bullet is still able to load into the AR-15's magazines, but with a lower maximum capacity.

variants.name: Tracerless
variants.info:
Ammo that doesn't have the components that create weapon tracers.

Greater overall accuracy for less range performance and bullet penetration.

variants.name: .20 Tactical
variants.info:
Loads your LSV M/04 with .20 Tactical.
This uses the typical 30-round magazines! Increases overall bullet performance, rewards accuracy. Decreases reload time, but you'll be punished even more if shots are missed.

variants.name: .223 Rem
variants.info:
Civilian version of the 5.56x45mm NATO military round.

Reduces recoil at the cost of ranged damage, bullet speed and a little bit of penetration and suppression.
Also slightly boosts aim speed!

Decreases camera recoil.
+2.5% Aiming speed.
-7% Min damage.
-25% Max range.
-8% Penetration and Suppression.

variants.name: Beta C Drum Mag
variants.info:
A large 100 round Beta-C drum magazine!
Allows you to fire for a long time at the cost of walk walkspeed, your aim, sprint and equip transition speeds and increases reload time significantly!

variants.name: Armor Piercing
variants.info:
Changes your ammunition to green tipped armor piercing rounds.
Increases bullet penetration (+30%) and torso damage multiplier (+5%) but reduces damage up close (-5%) range (-5%) and head damage multiplier (-4%).

variants.name: Hollow Point
variants.info:
Changes your ammunition to hollow point rounds.
Increases damage up close (+15%), maximum damage range (+17.5%)!
But reduces torso multiplier (-15%), penetration (-62.5%) and bullet speed (-10%).
